g.text: Each marker is one run. Horizontal bars extend to the offer. Each panel has its own rate scale. The dashed line marks 120 seconds.

text.style: font-size: 8.55px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #465866

g.text: The p95 uses inputs with an observed durable upper bound. The clinical verdict uses every accepted input. Counts and repeat ranges accompany the figure.
